This is a **draft**, visible only during local development, used to check the styling of Chinese text, English words mixed in, inline code `tokenizer.decode(ids)`, and links [like this](https://wenjia.me). Punctuation spacing, justified alignment, and line height should all look natural, and long paragraphs should not cause horizontal scrolling on mobile devices.

## Code Blocks

Extremely long code lines should scroll horizontally within the code block, rather than breaking the page layout:

```python
def stream(prompt: str, max_new_tokens: int = 256):
    ids = tokenizer.encode(prompt, return_tensors="pt")
    for token_id in model.generate(ids, max_new_tokens=max_new_tokens, do_sample=True, temperature=0.7, top_p=0.95, streamer=True):
        yield tokenizer.decode(token_id, skip_special_tokens=True)
```

## Mathematical Formulas

Inline formulas $p(x_t \mid x_{<t})$ are mixed with the body text, while standalone formulas occupy their own line:

$$
\mathcal{L}(\theta) = -\sum_{t=1}^{T} \log p_\theta\left(x_t \mid x_1, x_2, \ldots, x_{t-1}\right)
$$

## Lists, Quotes, and Tables

- First item, containing `inline code`
- Second item, slightly longer, to verify that indentation after line breaks aligns correctly, especially on narrow screens like phones
